blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The 2026-10-19 census places 99.9992% of circulating IUSD on Ethereum and 0.0008% on Monad. At Ethereum block26224759 (2026-10-19T06:13:59Z), ReceiptToken0x48f9e38f3070ad8945dfeae3fa70987722e3d89c has zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots and verified immutable ordinary ERC20 transfer logic. Its burnFrom first spends holder allowance. CoreControlled inherits Pausable, but ReceiptToken does not use ERC20Pausable, override the transfer path with a pause gate, or guard transfers with whenNotPaused; pause()/paused() alone do not stop holders transferring. Governor role grants cannot bypass that allowance or rewrite this immutable ERC20. emergencyAction executes external CALLs, not arbitrary holder-balance writes. There is no declared parent. The former decisive Tempo TIP-20 deployment0x20c000000000000000000000ab02d39df30bd17e has totalSupply()=0 at Tempo block44841243 (2026-10-19T06:15:30Z). Its previously pinned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE grant to infiniFi Safe0x80608f852d152024c0a2087b16939235fec2400c at block22529597, creation-admin revocation22529608, 4-of-7 Safe, transferPolicyId1 and paused=false remain peripheral documentary/on-chain control evidence, not an asset-level Yes basis. BSC OFT supply is also0 at block128504924. For reserves, the freshly read issuer API https://eth-api.infinifi.xyz/api/protocol/data reports positive farms totaling $66569173.217697; its aggregate TVL is $995.249103 lower, so use the larger farm sum as denominator. Conservative numerator $41924640.418443 comprises native USDC lending claims plus Fasanara mGLO/Genesis, New Silver junior/senior and FalconX custodial fund/private-credit claims: 62.979061%, strictly above50%. Entire fxSAVE, stcUSD, PT-reUSD, sUSDC and Sentora nested positions are retained in the denominator and excluded from numerator; no transitive pro-rating is needed to cross the threshold. The evidence therefore supports Upstream rather than Yes: no demonstrated direct Yes/Possible on the material Ethereum token, but a measured issuer/custodian-controlled reserve majority.

oracleRisk.summary: infiniFi publishes its oracle inventory: the Pendle Oracle 0x9a9Fa8338dd5E5B2188006f1Cd2Ef26d921650C2 prices PT positions, and the protocol requires USDC/USD, PT and farm-asset prices for NAV calculations with staleness checks, circuit breakers and multiple sources where available. The farm-asset leg covers the private-credit and fund slices whose valuation is administrator fund NAV rather than a traded market price (the Fasanara Genesis Fund and mGLOBAL report monthly NAV with monthly redemptions; the New Silver slices carry week-plus bucket terms), so the binding pricing authority is privileged internal rather than an external market feed. Mint and redemption settle at accounting NAV, and no borrower liquidation engine consumes a collateral price.

branchApplicability.rationale: iUSD mint and redemption settle at protocol accounting NAV and the published oracle surfaces feed that NAV; no borrower branch, collateral-health ratio or liquidation price is evidenced, so the oracle review applies to the top-level pricing path only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: infiniFi's Ethereum ReceiptToken is the only canonical native-issuance route. BNB's InfiniFiOFT is a LayerZero burn/mint representation, while Tempo's TIP-20 IUSD and OFT Adapter are a lock/mint representation; their bridge contracts, issuer Safe administration, DVN/peer configuration, and Outland portal reconciliation are assessed here rather than in Mint Authority. The bridge review is source-enriched but blocked from clearance on the Outland path: message-authentication authority, complete destination outpost set, reconciliation cadence, and supply-conservation proof remain unresolved, so no cleared conservation claim is made. The Ethereum adapter and Outland portal mint paths have no verified immutable numeric ceiling, so their bridge-mint cap semantics are conservatively raiseable. The Tempo route remains the weakest documented durable route, so the profile uses external-lock-mint. The issuer-listed Plasma address is excluded because pinned on-chain metadata identifies it as iUSDT rather than iUSD. At Ethereum block 26095983, RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER enumerated six members, including the two verified OutlandVault contracts 0x4197f2adfce9fdeb36b02e96737ddf646c841e45 and 0x77776f422b7eb0a95ccd35fbd088a5957d4408ea. This observation does not resolve their complete destination inventory or conservation checks.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum is the canonical ReceiptToken deployment. BNB's InfiniFiOFT is a LayerZero burn/mint representation whose _debit() burns on the source and _credit() mints on the destination; it is not an independent native collateral-liability domain.

Tempo TIP-20 IUSD is a representation paired with the LayerZero OFT Adapter. The adapter's token() read returns the TIP-20 address and its ISSUER_ROLE membership read is true; the route is lock/mint bridge machinery, not an independent infiniFi Core collateral-liability domain.

Their contract identities and portal entry points are known, but the evidence does not resolve the message-authentication authority, complete destination outpost set, reconciliation cadence, or conservation proof for every outpost. The delivery contracts remain in separate controls while this validator/conservation control stays unknown; no contract identity is treated as a validator. Reclassified 2026-09-01 under AUTHORITY-LADDER 9.46: the controlling party for this control is the external Outland portal message-authentication validation quorum itself, a rotating protocol-scoped operator set with no single controllerAddress to record. Its authority model is therefore validator-quorum, known but weak, graded no higher than a named issuer backend and never above a named multisig, rather than unknown. The unresolved roster, quorum, override and peer facts recorded above are unchanged; only the authority classification moved.
